Covered by Huffpost Top mobile app development company Top mobile app developers in India Visit our profile at AppFutura ‹ › Trusted by ‹ › Definition of IT Staff Augmentation Services IT Staff Augmentation in the IT world is an outsourcing strategy of hiring additional staff from Agicent on time sensitive basis to cater to the short-term or long-term Technical and development needs

In simple words, when a company hires external talent from us to work continuously on their projects and fill the tech gaps then it is a IT Staff Augmentation Service that they’re availing

IT Staff augmentation is the process of adding talent to your existing team through a third party

This could be anything from 10 engineers joining 10 different teams to a single developer with niche expertise

IT Staff augmentation removes the overhead associated with sourcing, recruiting, training, and retaining talent

It can help you meet short- and long-term technology goals with added flexibility and instant access to a high-quality talent pool

Discuss your goals with us Process of IT Staff Augmentation Services Our process is very simple, and starts with a simple Discovery Call followed by simple steps as follows: Step 1 - Discovery Call During the discovery call, we understand the skill-sets you need, the experience level (beginner, expert, senior), number of engineers needed and the lead time

Put the requirements as the clear “Service orders” and go back to our resource management team that does sourcing, recruitment, onboarding and everything else that you need to onboard the right candidates

Step 2 - Prelim Shortlisting and Interview by Agicent We source the right CVs from the inhouse resource pool or from the market within 3 days, get their details and line up them for our round of interview for the screening

Since we are a software development team ourselves, our CTO and senior Technical people take their preliminary round and establish more than 90% matching between the job profile and the candidates before we send them to you for further screening

In some case, we also give out technical tests or machine tests before shortlisting them for the final client facing round

We also get free trials from senior technical members just to make sure they are actually fit for the job

An HR round is also done by us where we evaluate the candidate on soft skills and overall character in order to establish their compatibility with the forthcoming job

Step 3 - Client Interview and Onboarding We lineup the shortlisted candidates to be interviewed by your technical team and once you give a go ahead we start the onboarding process

The onboarding process includes negotiating their notice period, their rates, working hours, relocation (if needed) and all other important aspects related to the job

Step 4 - Account Management: Post Onboarding That’s the beautiful part, no matter whether you hire one person from us or a team as large as 50 you’ll get a dedicated project manager and an account manager through out the lifecycle of our engagement

We introduce more project managers as the team size increases and put a super manager on the whole process

So even though the team will work at your disposal all the time, you’ll still have our backup management as well as close supervision and administration to ensure that the team you’ve hired is running smoothly and delivering the intended without burning extra budget

Step 5 - Billing and Invoicing Cycle An invoice for the services will be raised at the start of every work month that you can pay using various methods (both online or offline such as bank wire transfer)

We support almost all credit and debit cards and ACH transfers across the English speaking world and especially the United States of America

Up your game with Agicent’s IT Staff Augmentation Services Let’s Talk A Prominent Case Study in IT Staff Augmentation Triumph We are the experts in digital and mobility transformation, using codes, design, and lots of passion and innovation

Find out some incredible success stories of our IT Staff Augmentation and development services that created history

IT Staff Augmentation Services During the lockdown, we helped building a large team of deep tech software engineers in the domain of Telecom, DevOps, Embedded and also in banking industry for India’s largest IT Company TCS

We recruited super specialist software engineers on a variety of technologies for work from home setup and onboarded 9 of them in just a week and then added more people as the account grew

We hired across all the cities in the country, put account manager for client’s convenience and ran the smooth process which enabled the client to release there critical government level projects on time and within budget

Our billing cycle was smooth and transparent as we only put a transparent markup on the overcall cost of the resource to us

Our IT staff augmentation teams work across Telecom network projects, OTT Apps, Banking, retail, ecommerce, gaming, ERPs and Industrial and governmental projects

We successfully managed common challenges like last minute backing out of candidates using our own recruitment acumen that involved background checks, backup selected candidates, right two party beneficial agreements and some soft skills

Benefits of Our IT Staff Augmentation Services Contrary to traditional hiring, IT Staff augmentation shows more flexibility and freedom toward the team

Some of the key pros of IT staff augmentation include: Work with the top 5% of the talent Availing our IT staff augmentation services mean you are in to work with the best minds and talents in the given skill-set and industry

Based on your requirements, we bring you the finest of the resources in shortest amount of time possible

Quick Scaling on-Demand We know you are hiring us for the IT staff augmentation services because you want it urgent and therefore our whole recruitment process is designed in such a way that we don’t even call candidates who have more than a month’s notice period

Thanks to a large talented tech resource pool in India and our own inhouse teams, we never have to wait for the right candidate for more than 2 weeks ever

Flexibility We offer absolute flexibility to our clients, you can always scale up and down your team on a short notice period

As we have our inhouse team on multiple technologies also, we sometimes add new engineers in a matter of days rather than weeks

No HR Overload It will be Agicent taking care of all admin, HR, compliance, taxes related work and every tiny bit of that

So our clients can simply focus on the work with the team and nothing else

For handling their payrolls, taxes, insurance and leaves to keeping them motivated, involving in employee engagement programs and also in personality and skill development we do it all while you get the best work out of the team

No Hardware, Infrastructure, or facility overhead cost Our 18000 sq

dedicated facility is capable to host 300 people team under one roof and we can always expand our space whenever we need

We already have right infrastructure (computers, testing devices, internet lease lines, security walls, cloud repositories) already in place and paid for and you need not to pay anything additional for such things

Higher Control, Less Liability You can work directly with the team, prioritize the tasks the way that you please, use your own methodologies and communication process and even working hours while we take care of the liabilities

Cost Benefit & Transparent Pricing You get a huge cost benefit when you avail our IT staff augmentation services for both short and longer term engagements

You pay no cost for hiring, management, admin but only for the actual work

Also, Indian developers (even the top most ones) are still cost effective and quality oriented compared to any other software outsourcing destination in the world

Also, we transparently reveal you the cost of the resource to us and simply put our markup on top of that so you always know what you’re paying for and getting the best deal

We’ve spent 14 years hiring, negotiating and working with different experience level engineers and unlike large IT company’s we offer the same quality of resources at lesser price

With Agicent, you can get the best of our India’s solid IT Talent Pool and at a very reasonable cost

Dedicated Teams and Higher Productivity The team created for you will only work for you and no one else

Their dedicated work hours are noted in real time using tools like Time doctor and your project manager will have their productivity matrix and KPI handy every time

Reasons Why Companies Opt For IT Staff Augmentation IT Staff augmentation is a vast term when it comes to the profiles of professionals hired as an external source who will join the in-house team

But, precisely in case of a Tech company, IT staff augmentation is required under some circumstances such as – In incorporating new and advanced technology to reach and meet the dynamic advancements rapidly and also to the market demands

Service-based organizations cracking short-term projects, instead of hiring for the long-term full-time team, IT staff augmentation can enable the company to accomplish and fulfill more effectively and in an optimizing manner

For example, in the case of an app development company aiming to develop a multi-platform app, they can simply go for IT staff augmentation to build a platform-specific team

For long term cost benefits, flexibility of operations, less management and compliance overload, and less recruitment hassles

For example, an app development company supposed to launch any new feature or any bug fixing requires more manpower

Staff augmentation can enable the company to meet the same, without disturbing in-house employees who might be working on other projects

History of IT Staff Augmentation The term IT staff augmentation was initiated in the early 1980s-1990s

However, this term does not involve any kind of documented history or any persona associated with it

Staff Augmentation is one of the outsourcing models that was followed during the early rise of temporary employment agencies

In the 1970s-1980s, when IT consulting firms began their expansion, IT Staff augmentation was one of the elements they integrated, and with the surge of globalization and the impact of the Gig economy since the 2010s till present staff augmentation has shown major prevalence in the industry

Different Models of IT Staff Augmentation Based on the location from where the team is been hired Offshore Model: When the team is hired from a country other than where the client’s business is being set up

It is a cost-effective approach as generally staff is hired from a country where labor costs are low

Onshore Model: When the team is hired from the native country itself

However, this kind of IT staff augmentation model promotes team integrity because of customary cultures

Nearshore Model: When the team members are hired from nearby countries, generally with similar time zones

Based on how Resources are engaged and organized Dedicated Team: When the team exclusively works for the client, generally preferred in case of high-priority projects

This kind of model commits long long-term partnership and flexibility

Time and Material: The model is known as “pay as you use” or “pay as you go”

In this model, the client is being charged based on the hours the staff is working for their organization

It gives transparency to the project and protects clients from the worry of huge prices

Fixed-price: This kind of model is generally preferred when the scope of the project is predetermined as well as when the requirements are properly defined

Based on roles and responsibilities of service provider Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT): The service provider serves for a short period, it first manages the team during the build phase and later transfers it over to the client side such that controls are with the client

IT Staff Augmentation as a Service (SAaaS): This model is generally used for the on- demand workforce as a temporary service

Things to Avoid in IT Staff Augmentation IT Staff augmentation is always successful when done with proper planning and vision, however here are some of the common mistakes that need to be avoided for a successful IT staff augmentation strategy: Improper evaluation and selection of the candidate That’s why at Agicent we do our own evaluation before sending anyone to be interviewed at the client’s end

Thanks for our own more than a decade long expertise in software development, we can evaluate and screen out the incompetent candidates right at the round 1

Lack of Planning and Management For any task to be accomplished properly what is required most is planning, any loophole in planning may lead to inconsistency which will ultimately create failure

You must define the KPIs, deliverables, and overall expectations well documented before initiating a IT staff augmentation team

Improper Communication Effective communication is the foremost element required in all avenues

In case of any miscommunication or misunderstanding it may lead to baffling situations and therefore can affect the project’s growth

Poorly defined scope and requirements In the case of unclear requirements during the discovery calls of service providers and clients, may lead to suboptimal results

Mismatched Company Culture Sometimes even the right skilled engineers may turn out to be a not fit for the job and that may happen due to reasons like previous company’s culture, domain experience, or simply because of having no experience in working with the English speaking clients

That’s why we check language skills as the part of the pre-screening process

Overrunning Budgetary Although IT Staff augmentation is preferred as it has the benefit that it is cost-effective

However, improper management may lead to cost overrunning and therefore may cause its failure

So even though IT Staff augmentation team work on ongoing projects, you should always have a budget range in mind before initiating a team

Inadequate Output Proposal The goal must be SMART, i.e

Specific, measurable, achievable, realistic, and time-bound

Any unrealistic expectation may hinder the process

#ClientSpeaks Learn more about our processes from our clients

Their IT Staff Augmentation services are as high quality as their product development services

We have moved all our technical work and teams to them along with the core development work from our projects, and they are just doing everything that is needed ahead of the time and in great quality

New York, USA Best practices for Successful IT Staff Augmentation IT Staff Augmentation holds the articulation between the two distinct organizations i.e

a client and a service provider and therefore this whole process requires some strategic approaches to make it successful

Some of them are: Sweat during the screening process, get trials when possible Proper screening, verification and validation of candidate’s experience is a must

Also, their soft skills and overall job fitment to the work as an individual is to be evaluated

If candidates are ready for that, then we should always get a trial work done in order to be double sure of their capabilities

Strategic and Conceptual Planning Both the service providers as well as the client should be very well planned about the project ideas and the process of integrating augmented staff with in-house teams and expected duration of the project

The goal must be clear and should be well-defined and communicated to the all stake holders involved

Clear KPIs, regular performance follow-ups and feedback sessions Once after the onboarding of augmented staff, the performance metrics of staff should be tracked, and constructive feedback should be provided to them

Confidentiality and Security Adhering to robust methods of security and safeguarding intellectual property, and sensitive data is mandatory and considered as an ethical practice of IT staff augmentation

Ensuring a productive and energetic environment The works ethics should be clearly defined, and both the client and vendor team should work in a progressive and productive environment

The teams dedicated to the client do have to dwell with other teams as well and therefore company vide employee engagement activities, personal development opportunities, and right incentives for high performance must be there

leveraging our expertise of skilled professionals you can boost your team and can revolutionize your business

We provide dedicated teams whether you want short term assistance or long-term association, we foster innovation which can help you achieve remarkable success and deliver exceptional results

How long does it take to see the first set of CVs? Ans: In case of regular web and mobile technologies, you get to see the CVs of very competent candidates instantly since we've these teams already inhouse

For most of our clients, it took them 5 days to select a candidate and 2 to 3 weeks to onboard them

Is there a minimum duration that you require from the client to commit to before onboarding a resource? Ans: Not always

For example, the resources we already have on our rolls can be deployed instantly without any minimum commitment from your side

However, in case when we source the resource from the market exclusively for you from day 1 then in that case certain duration commitment is needed from your side (usually 3 to 6 months) for obvious reasons

How do you manage candidates backing out at the last moment? Ans: We've seen this happening a lot during the pandemic days and figured out and applied a multi-pronged approach to fix this problem

Some things we do - - We effectively communicate the job, KRAs, timings and all other perks and terms of the job to the candidate before we even shortlist them for the next round

Most of the times, candidates can back out due to having non clarity on the project or client so we ensure they are on the same page as the first step

- We shortlist and select backup similar resources as well for such situations only, usually we always have 2 selected candidates for one job so if one backs out the other can quickly fill in

In case of regular skills like react native, iOS, Android, .NET, Java core, React.js, Wordpress, PHP we usually have more than 2 selects all the time

Do you hire external project managers or use your own project managers? Ans: Both, we have pretty solid inhouse trained and experienced project managers who can take up the job whenever needed if they are available

We go about hiring an external project manager only when our own PM team is full with projects or when you need a specially and similar to your project-experienced PM only for your own project

Do you do IT staff augmentation for only larger size teams or can I hire just 1 or 2 resources too? Ans: You can start with as low as one resource requirement, we have no minimum threshold limit so start with just one person or 100 - you'll find us equally good

Ofcourse, the larger size projects will need little more lead time and multi-layer management compared to small teams but our promise remains the same which is - you always get a useful team from us that delivers and we ensure the delivery at our own cost and efforts

Do you do only IT Staff Augmentation service or non Tech Staff Augmentation too? Ans: We offer both IT Tech Staff Augmentation as well as non tech IT staff augmentation for different non tech skills like digital marketing, seo, email marketer, customer care executive (Voice, non voice), Virtual assistant, Back office accounts, Market researchers and so on

Basically, we provide resources for all business functions and roles across tech and non tech fields

How do I pay for the services, are there any taxes? Ans: You can pay through bank wire transfer or payment gateway link

Usually the payments are 100% upfront for a month though in some cases we offer 50% twice a month cycle also

We support all the widely used cards, ACH, Bank cards

There are no taxes on our services when exported to the USA or anywhere else outside India

How do you ensure that the team is working with best efficiency for all the billable hours and there is no lull time? Ans: Our process ensure real time communication and status updates

The timesheets are collaborative and can be seen by all the stake holders anytime and questions can be raised wherever applicable

keep the things well in check and in a more automated manner

Can we visit your office before or after assigning you the IT staff augmentation work? Ans: Sure, we'll be happy to welcome you at our office anytime

We do have some clients who have their project owners working with us right from our office time to time especially in case of larger size projects

We are always open to make our processes more flexible and transparent so the clients get the best out of their investments and also gel up with our team too for the long term

Do I need to pay for computers and other infrastructure as well along with the monthly fee? Ans: No, we already have an infrastructure that can support 300 people in our own premises and we have the capabilities to double the size on a short notice

So unless there is a special equipment that you need besides computers and internet and regular IT hardware, you don't have to pay anything additional besides for the services Q

Can I use the IT staff augmentation team for more than 1 project? Ans: Ofcourse, the team is dedicated to you and you may feel free to use them for one project or many

Can the team work in my timezone? Ans: Yes, we offer a minimum 4 hours of timezone overlap to every customer across the world and if you are in US EST then we can offer you 100% timezone availability

Are all your resources from India or can you procure teams from other countries too? Ans: Mostly we create IT staff augmentation teams in our Indian office only, though in some cases we can hired directly right from the USA and deploy them onsite

We are a legal entity in the US also, registered with the state of Georgia

content:
Fractional CTO Hiring a Fractional CTO as a service is a cost-effective and time-saving option for startups

Many founders today explore fractional CTO services because hiring a full-time CTO at $250K per year simply doesn’t make sense, especially for bootstrapped or early-stage startups without a technical cofounder

We provide access to experienced technical leaders at a highly reasonable rate (around $50/hour for a CTO), delivered on a flexible, need-based model

You bring in a fractional chief technology officer only when required and pay strictly for the time you use

That means immediate CTO-level input without long-term overhead or unnecessary burn

We’ve been working as a Fractional CTO partner for startups for over a decade

Our role goes beyond just defining technical architecture—we actively build products from MVP to full scale

So when you work with us, you don’t just get CTO-as-a-service, you get a complete product development team ready to execute what your business and technology roadmap demands

Talk to our CTOs Fractional CTO Cost Why Fractional CTO? Recognised by the best Press Released Covered by Daily Mail Best App Development Companies for Startups 2021 Our Interview with eFM Reviewed 5 Stars on Venturepact Top Mobile App Development Company Verified Profile on Inc

Covered by Huffpost Top mobile app development company Top mobile app developers in India Visit our profile at AppFutura ‹ › Trusted by ‹ › What Is a Fractional CTO as a Service, and What They Do? A fractional CTO does all that a regular on-the-job CTO (Chief Technology Officer) would do, but on a need basis

A Fractional CTO is an advanced level highly experienced Technical Leader who must have had successful experience in creating digital products from the early stage as an Engineer or senior engineer and then as someone who has taken leadership level decisions for building a Technical Product as a whole

At Agicent, you get to work with Fractional CTOs who have created more than 15 digital products (Apps, web Apps, backends, Algorithms) for the startups from the MVP level to full scaled products used by millions of users

(Example – HASfit App, Wellcure, Aiko & Egor, Panasonic Lumix and more)

In the startup scenario, A Fractional CTO does product design, technology identification and also gets involved in some regular “implementation work” as an “over-viewer” or as a “Tech owner or Tech custodian”

In a mature startup where product is already there in the Market, a Fractional CTO becomes more involved into strategic decisions and roadmaps then just implementations and solution designing

To simplify, these are some of the major tasks a fractional chief technology officer performs (but not limited to): Fractional CTO for Early-Stage Startups Is Involved In/ And Leading the Following Tasks: 1

Understanding Your Product Idea and Long-Term Goal and Budget Also Feasibility Study: This is the first task essentially

The Fractional CTO understands what you want to create thoroughly, divide the total feature list of your product into “Regular features”, “Unique features”, “Complex Features” and goes to the next Step

A Fractional CTO is very helpful in doing the feasibility study on the “Complex or unique features” to establish if they are doable or not with the current set of technologies in the world, and if doable then how wise it is to do them

Help You Create the MVP Quickly: A fractional chief technology officer will guide you to create a lean but useful MVP version of your product and launch within weeks and then put that into iteration for gaining more market

Tech Stack Identification, Architecture Design, Building Technology and Product Development Roadmap: Based on the specific demands of your product, a Fractional CTO will identify the Technical Stack to be used to achieve the goals and also considering the long term scalability of the product

He will also research and identify where to use open-source, where to use cross platform or native Tech, which external libraries to use, what kind of server to use and for which configuration and so on

If you’re a small startup, then a Fractional CTO will definitely play the role of the solution Architect too

Which means, he will create the architecture of the product to be made starting from its data model, and will also help you in creating the wireframes or source someone to do the same

Depending upon the Time-to-market goal and budget in hand, a Fractional CTO will strive to identify a development approach that works the best in the startup’s interest

Basically, a FCTO breaks down the whole product idea into “actionable achievable tasks”

The CTO also maps out security requirements, evaluates AI integration where relevant, and identifies practical ways to implement early stage security measures, model integration, and system performance and leaving a scope for future improvements

In such cases, AI consulting with our CTO helps you align these decisions with your existing stack and long term scalability goals through AI development services

Identification of the Resources Needed, Selecting Them and Assigning Them the Tasks: Fractional CTO will identify which different skill sets are needed to perform the tasks of development

And then they shortlist, interview and select the right engineers whether from the market or from the Tech Agency like Agicent

For example, he may choose a Full Stack developer to do both Front end and backend of your web app while a cross platform developer on react native or flutter to implement the mobile app to get more work done with less engineers

Designing the Technology and Project Management Process: The Fractional CTO will decide or participate in the decision of finalizing a developmental model which could be Agile or Extreme programming or good old waterfall

He’ll guide to design Delivery expectations, quality expectations, and schedules along with project manager

The Fractional CTO will also setup essential protocols related to software development i.e

setting up Code Repository, Backup Plans and strategy, Setting up staging/ test server or interim App distribution protocol, Live Server, Access Control, IP restrictions, Server security measures and much more

On a Funny note, most of the times the CTOs role starts from buying the domain and setting up Emails too – which means they are your go to guy whenever you are stuck at a Technology thing whether big or small

Overseeing the Developmental Operations: Although CTOs in big companies are not involved in day-to-day implementation and tech operations but in case of early Stage Startups they are all what they have in terms of Tech leadership

So they get involved in implementation as a Supervisor or a guide and review deliveries, give feedback to the team, help them with troubleshooting when needed, offer them alternative solutions and also take feedback from the development team and implement what is right

Guiding the Startup in Sourcing the Talent: Depending upon the project needs and budget, a Fractional CTO may suggest you to either outsource the whole project to a proper Development Company like Agicent or to distribute different components of your product to different vendors, or help you creating an in-house development team or may also ask you to use a freelancer

For smaller tasks, they may ask you to use a one-off freelancer while for perpetual work in a cost-effective way they’ll opt for an Software Outsourcing Company like Agicent

Collaboration With Different Departments Whenever It Comes to Technology: Your CTO is needed by all departments namely your development team, your marketing team or vendor, your Finance team, your Admin team, your HR Team (ofcourse) and anyone else

Most of the times they need a CTO for one-off basis except in the case of the development and HR team as they need a CTO on more day-to-day basis than others

But this Tech Leader must be efficient and broad enough to collaborate with all of them as they rely on the CTO level decisions when it comes to using the Technology for any operation of the startup

A Fcto Represents You in Front of Investors or Relevant Audience: Your investors would be curious to talk to your CTO always, to throw critical questions, asking about big technology aspects, security aspects, IPR things and so on

The Fractional CTO will be equipped with handy knowledge to answer all these questions, take feedback and also give reasons behind using the certain technology Stack

Setting up KPIs and KRAs, and Remuneration and Incentives Benchmark: A Fractional CTO will define KPIs for your product and teams and KRAs for your engineer team according to their job roles and responsibilities and also a method to measure and compare their performances

With a great knowledge of the Engineering market, a Fractional CTO will also help you in figuring out salaries and remunerations of the inhouse and offshore team alike

Fractional CTO for Bigger Startups Who Already Have a Product on Live, and Some Funds in the Kitty, Would Do the Following: All or a Part of What a Fractional CTO Does in an Early Stage Startups: More Strategic Involvement: Assuming that a bigger or mature startup will have more Technical leaders and Project and Product Managers, the role of the Fractional CTO here would be more focused on creating short and long term Strategies related to product development and Technology as a whole

For example, the CTO may decide to change the payment gateway from X vendor to Y if Y is offering a better deal and same applies on many other aspects too

Creating and Owning Distributed Development Teams: In today’s remote culture, most of the startups are relying heavily on geographically distributed teams

The CTO will define which team does what, and also design their collaboration protocol, setup up KPIs and KRAs and oversees and makes sure the work is being done as expected

Helping in Creating Partnerships and Profitable Collaborations With Other SAAS Providers or Tech Companies: You need your Fractional CTO whenever you want to forge a tech Partnership with another technology provider or a SaaS provider

For example, you may need to partner with a local news App to source News feed and you need their API

The CTO will help you getting a better revenue sharing deal here

On other way around, some other Tech company may want to use your technology to enhance their products and your CTO will help you in deciding the pricing for your Tech APIs and also method to render them securely only to the designated partners

Helping in Identifying and Forecasting the Technology Budget: For the mature startups who already have products in the market, it is imperative to keep on updating and enhancing their product line

This comes with a budget, and a Fractional CTO will be instrumental in identifying the same and will also creates a plan that cuts the costs down

The budget they figure out is what you show to the investors or funders and specifically “ask” for what you need in terms of next growth stage

Team Transition: A Fractional CTO will guide the process of Transition when you outsource all or a part of the work to an offshore team or vice versa when you bring back your outsourced work and create your own inhouse development team

Talk to a Fractional CTO for Free! Let’s Talk Why to Hire a Fractional CTO, what are the benefits of CTO as a service? The tasks that are performed by the Fractional CTO as mentioned above, are the right reasons to hire a Fractional CTO as a service

Simplifying the benefits of Fractional CTO as follows – You get a Tech Leader in less cost You get leadership-level technical expertise at a fraction of the cost of a full-time CTO

This is exactly why many startups today rely on fractional CTO services to stay lean while still making strong technical decisions

For startups, we charge $50 to $100/hour for a Fractional CTO, and even if you use them for 100 hours, you pay just $5000 for a Tech Leader’s time

Immediate Action and Results Fractional CTO as a service is an immediate service in nature, so whenever you hire a FCTO they start working right away

Similarly, you don’t need to pay them when you don’t use their services

Saves Time and Hassle There is no time or cost consumption in sourcing, shortlisting, interviewing, and onboarding a Fractional CTO

Our FCTOs are super competent, you talk to them for 30 minutes, tell them your current needs and you’ll know if they are able to help or not

The contracts are simple and quick and we always start the CTO as a service within two days of signing the contract

Advantage Variety of Experience Since they are fractional, they tend to work on more startups and products than a regular CTO who spends all their time on one product at a time

Which means, you get a more versatile experienced and street-smart CTO who just means business

Efficiency of existing processes You save a lot of time of your internal development team which should focus on development and delivery and engaging them in researching and gauging tech options always hamper your ongoing developments

So when you hire a Fractional CTO – they do the research and tech decision making part gauging all options and consequences while the Internal development team and keep focusing on delivering what they are assigned to

Explore hidden opportunities and gain new perspective As Fractional CTOs tend to be a part of more products and startups than a regular one, they sometimes give you very easy and quick solutions to monstrous looking problems

As we funnily say, sometimes a google sheet can solve your collaboration problem instead of spending $$ on a collaboration SaaS product

When you’ve the brains with experience in action – the complex becomes simple

When to hire a Fractional CTO as a service? Since it is the startups that tend to hire Fractional CTO as a Service more than well grown companies, let us focus mainly on them and find out When to hire a Fractional CTO as a Service: If you are a non-technical founder or have just developers in the team but no technical leader with Authority and Experience, you should hire a Fractional CTO as soon as you can

Whenever you have the product idea ready, you should hire a Fractional CTO without wasting much time

You need a CTO for all the tasks (starting from Tech Architecture, sourcing team, reading Tech contracts etc) as listed in the first section of this writeup

Whenever you are looking to scale your MVP to the next level, you should consult a fractional CTO who will help you in finalizing the next Tech Stack, Server side, Development Approach and also security

When you find that your current Tech Teams are not collaborating efficiently with the business team and it is difficult for them to translate your business needs into technical scope of the work or vice versa

Whenever you are about to outsource your software development project or about to create your own inhouse team, or about to transition between the two - you need the fractional CTO to guide you through the same

Whenever you are needing to partner with other tech providers or SaaS providers to use their technology onto your App/ Software or vice versa, you need the Fractional CTO to strike a better deal with them

Whenever you are about to pump more funds into the product marketing and scaling – consult with a Fractional CTO

Whenever you are about to go raising another round of funding, you carry along your Fractional CTO to “Technically represent” your startup in front of the investors and answer their questions

Whenever your regular CTO position is vacant and you have not enough time to source/ select/ onboard another full time CTO you should quickly hire a Fractional CTO as-a-service from Agicent or any other competent Technical Partner

You can Hire a Fractional CTO along with the Dev Team Talk to us Cost of Hiring a Fractional CTO as a Service The basic cost is $50/ hour and ideally should be hired for minimum 50 hours at once as one needs that much of time to do anything significant as the CTO

There is no setup fee, no project management fee, no separation fee

The hourly cost will be less if you hire the CTO regularly for more than 50 hours every month for 6 months

The hourly cost may increase to further if you hire the CTO for super complex tasks like audit of existing product

How does a Fractional CTO keep the confidentiality of my Product idea? Ans: Our CTO as well as whole Agicent will sign an NDA with you in proper legal valid form and that will safeguard your confidentiality interest

Also, since we strive to work longer term with our client we make sure that the integrity is maintain and upheld for years and years

Do you offer software development services along with the Fractional CTO as a service? Ans: Oh yes! In fact, our long-term experience in offering software development services is one of the factors why each of our CTOs for hire have individual experience of working on more than 15 products as the tech leader

We are happy to offer you a CTO as a service on demand and also the development team, designers, testers and any other personnel that is needed for your successful product

What is the Technical and domain expertise of your Fractional CTOs? Ans: Our CTOs are well versed with Web, Mobile, and backend technologies

They have been full stack developers, architects and principal engineers before picking the role of the CTO so technologies come handy to them

Especially in case of creating SaaS products and Mobile Apps, Algorithms, AI products our CTO team is super hands on

For example, our leaders are well versed with .NET, Java, React.js, MongoDB, node.js, native app development, python, Ruby, databases, OpenAI APis and more

In terms of domains, our CTOs have lead projects in Healthcare/ Health Tech, FinTech, EdTech, IoT, Telecom, Retail Tech, Property Tech, games and many other domains

Can you share your client references for whom you worked as Fractional CTO? Ans: Yes, some of them are publicly displayed on our website like HASfit, Aiko & Egor, VaycoPlus and if you want to talk one on one then feel free to email us at sales@agicent.com

Do I get the same Fractional CTO every time I ask for or different? Ans: You’ll always get the same Fractional CTO so that you don’t have to do any repeat knowledge transfer

You can use our CTO today for a month and may want them again after 5 months and you will find the same person again

Can I only use your development services and not CTO or Just CTO but not developers? Ans: Yes, its totally your choice

However, since our CTOs have a physical easy access to the team of developers and associated personnel you will always find it beneficial to use us as a whole

However you can always start with just Fractional CTO as a service or Just development team

Custom Web Application Development Your Vision, Coded to Perfection: Every web application starts with an idea—a vision to deliver real results

At Agicent, we go beyond development; we craft experiences that redefine how your business connects with the world

Since 2010, we build feature-rich AI-loaded applications using advanced technologies like React , the MERN stack , and Advanced captive and third-party APIs

So, whether it’s an AI-featured mobile-first design or a progressive web app (PWA), we have the expertise to bring your vision to life flawlessly and efficiently

What sets Agicent apart At Agicent, we don’t just manage projects—we take ownership

Our hands-on approach ensures every detail is executed with precision and care

With over a decade of experience, we bring technical excellence, proactive communication, and a deep understanding of your business needs to every project

Our commitment? Achieving project success, no matter the challenge

Proven Expertise With 14 years of experience, we’ve mastered the art of building high-performing, scalable web applications

Our work has been featured by major platforms like Apple, and we continue to push the boundaries of innovation

Cutting-Edge Technology We utilize the latest tools and technologies like React, MERN stack, PHP/Laravel, and full-stack Java to craft seamless, powerful web applications tailored to your business needs

Cost-Effective Process No surprises, no hidden fees

Our fixed-price model ensures that your project stays on budget without compromising on quality

All Under One Roof From initial planning to launch and ongoing support, everything is handled by our in-house experts

You’ll never need to juggle multiple vendors; we provide end-to-end solutions that cover all your web development needs

Your feedback and vision drive our process, ensuring that the final product aligns perfectly with your expectations

We treat your project as our own, working closely with you at every step

Agile and Flexible Time and market changes are important

That’s why we follow an agile development methodology—allowing us to adapt, pivot, and make necessary adjustments during the project lifecycle

Scalability at the Core We build applications that grow with your business

Whether you're a startup looking to expand or an enterprise scaling up, we design web apps that are ready to evolve alongside you

End-to-End Support Our services don’t stop at development

We provide ongoing support and maintenance to ensure your app is always up-to-date, secure, and running at peak performance

Our Core Services : Tailored solutions for every business need 1

Custom Web Application Development Services We turn your standard website into a highly interactive, personalized web app or create one from scratch based on your vision

With innovation in web apps more dynamic than ever in 2024, our web app development agency is fully equipped to build diverse, cutting-edge web applications

Different Types of Web Applications in Web App Development No single web application fits all

The right type depends on your Business’s nature , Target audience , and Goals

E-commerce Development We design and develop user-friendly and high-performing e-commerce websites that drive revenue and offer a seamless shopping experience

From storefront design to payment integration, we handle every aspect to ensure your digital store operates smoothly and delivers results

Web Portal Development We specialize in building feature-rich web portals that facilitate seamless interactions

Whether it’s a customer service portal, a B2B platform, or an internal dashboard, we develop solutions that fit your business model perfectly

SaaS Web App Development SaaS web app development is at the heart of our core services, enabling businesses to deliver flawless, cloud-based solutions to their users

We specialize in building scalable, secure, and high-performing SaaS applications tailored to diverse industries

From multi-tenant architecture to seamless integrations with third-party APIs, our development process ensures a robust user experience

With expertise in modern frameworks and cloud platforms, we craft SaaS apps such as DawnHealth that are easy to maintain and update, allowing your business to scale effortlessly

Custom CMS Development Managing content shouldn’t be a challenge

Our custom CMS solutions are built to be flexible and user-friendly, empowering you to update and control your content effortlessly

Whether it’s for a website, portal, or web app, our CMS systems are tailored to your unique requirements, giving you full control over your content

Enterprise Web Development For large organizations, we offer enterprise-level web development that’s designed to help your business succeed in the digital age

We build scalable, secure, and high-performance applications, perfectly suited for enterprise-level operations

Web App Support and Maintenance Your web application deserves ongoing care

Our support and web maintenance services ensure that your app performs at its best long after launch

We continuously monitor for bugs, performance bottlenecks, and security threats to keep your application running smoothly and securely, whether it is WordPress maintenance or another CMS

API & Backend Development We build robust APIs and scalable backends to support the infrastructure behind your apps

Whether for mobile or web platforms, our systems are designed for security and scalability, ensuring smooth integration and performance

Custom Admin Panels Our custom admin panels are designed for ease of use and efficiency, providing you with full control over your business operations

Whether you need to manage content, monitor performance, or oversee day-to-day activities, our admin panels offer everything you need in one user-friendly interface

Industries We Serve At Agicent, we bring our expertise in web and app development to a wide range of industries

Our tailored solutions help businesses of all kinds thrive in the digital space, providing the right technology to meet their unique needs

Healthcare We empower healthcare providers with secure, HIPAA-compliant digital solutions

From patient portals to telehealth platforms, our custom web apps improve patient care and streamline operations

Education & E-Learning From interactive learning tools to student management systems, our solutions are designed to enhance the learning experience for students and educators alike

Real Estate Our solutions make it easy to manage listings, track leads, and close deals for real estate companies to connect with buyers and sellers through dynamic websites and custom CRM systems

Logistics & Transportation Our solutions help logistics companies improve operations with custom tracking systems, inventory management tools, and fleet management platforms

We provide technology that keeps your business moving

SaaS Build scalable SaaS applications that allow businesses to offer cloud-based services efficiently

Our team ensures that these platforms are robust, flexible, and easy for your customers to access

Automotive In the fast-paced automotive industry, we create innovative web applications for inventory management, online sales, and customer engagement, helping businesses stay ahead in the digital world

Fitness The industry is thriving, with a growing demand for custom web applications to enhance user experiences and streamline operations

From virtual workout platforms to personalized nutrition plans and gym management systems, our expertise in web development ensures scalable and engaging solutions

Travel & Hospitality To enhance customer experiences, our custom web app agency helps businesses create smooth and enjoyable journeys from start to finish, whether through booking systems or guest management portals

Retail We assist retailers in creating dynamic digital storefronts that offer a flawless shopping experience across devices

Our solutions focus on user engagement, fast performance, and ease of management

Media & Entertainment From streaming services to interactive apps, we build interactive platforms for media companies and entertainment brands to deliver rich content and engage audiences

Food & Beverage Our custom web and mobile apps for restaurants, food delivery services, and suppliers, ensure efficient online ordering, menu management, and seamless customer experiences

Nonprofits For nonprofit organizations, we can help you create donation platforms, event management tools, and custom websites that help spread awareness and encourage community support

Telecommunications We work with telecom providers to create customer service portals, billing systems, and custom web applications that improve customer satisfaction and streamline internal processes

Fintech Whether it's online banking, payment gateways, or investment platforms, we help finance companies offer reliable and user-friendly digital experiences

No matter the industry, our custom web app development team is ready to deliver a digital solution that fits your business’s unique needs, helping you stay competitive and thrive in today’s digital landscape

Technology Stack and Web App Development Tools we excel in At Agicent, our approach to web application development combines the best tools and technologies, whether you need a small web application or a complex enterprise platform, to bring your vision to life

Frontend Web App Development Technologies React 1 As experts in React, we build fast, single-page applications (SPAs), and its component-based architecture enables reusable and maintainable code, allowing us to scale your applications effortlessly

Angular 2 We use Angular to build enterprise-level applications with complex front-end logic

Angular’s two-way data binding and dependency injection streamline development for highly interactive web apps

Vue.js 3 Lightweight and flexible, Vue.js is ideal for building performant and easy-to-maintain applications

Our team has used Vue.js to deliver high-speed, real-time dashboards for financial clients

HTML/CSS 4 These core technologies enable us to create mobile-first, responsive designs that work flawlessly across devices

Tailwind CSS 5 For quick prototyping and building consistent, aesthetically pleasing UIs, we use these CSS frameworks

Tailwind's utility-first approach ensures a clean, minimal design, while Bootstrap offers a vast component library

Backend Web App Development Technologies Node.js 1 We specialize in Node.js for building fast, scalable server-side applications

Paired with Express.js, Node.js enables us to build APIs and real-time applications efficiently, such as a real-time messaging app we created for a healthcare provider

PHP/Laravel 2 For clients preferring PHP, we use Laravel, a robust PHP framework known for its elegant syntax and built-in security features

It’s ideal for creating complex web applications like e-commerce sites and SaaS platforms

Java 3 With its focus on stability, Java ensures secure, high-performance applications, such as a banking portal we developed using Spring Boot

Python/Django & Flask 4 We use Python with Django and Flask for rapid application development

Django’s built-in admin panel and ORM system make it ideal for data-driven applications, while Flask provides flexibility for smaller, modular applications

Databases and Storage A powerful database architecture is key to the performance of your web application, and we work with both SQL and NoSQL databases depending on your needs

Firebase For serverless applications, we use Firebase to handle real-time data synchronization, user authentication, and hosting

We used Firebase for a mobile-first e-commerce platform, to allow real-time updates to product inventories

MongoDB For applications with unstructured or semi-structured data, we use MongoDB, a flexible NoSQL database that is ideal for real-time applications such as content management systems (CMS) and social networks

Redis We integrate Redis as an in-memory data store to improve performance by caching frequently accessed data

It is often used in our projects for session management and real-time analytics

MySQL/PostgreSQL We use these relational databases for structured data that require complex queries

PostgreSQL is preferred for high-performance, data-intensive applications due to its scalability and advanced features

API Development and Integration We design and develop APIs that allow seamless communication between different parts of your application or third-party services

RESTful APIs Our expertise in building RESTful APIs ensures that your web application can communicate smoothly with mobile apps, third-party services, and other systems

GraphQL For more complex queries and efficient data retrieval, we use GraphQL

It enables us to fetch specific data from multiple resources in a single request, providing faster and more efficient APIs

Cloud Platforms and DevOps AWS (Amazon Web Services) 1 We leverage AWS for hosting, data storage, and cloud computing

Using services like AWS Lambda, S3, and EC2, we build scalable, serverless architectures, ensuring your application can handle traffic spikes without compromising performance.

Microsoft Azure 2 For enterprise clients, we use Azure’s cloud computing solutions to build secure and compliant applications

Azure’s app services and Kubernetes integration allow us to deploy and scale applications with ease

Google Cloud 3 With Google Cloud, we create scalable applications with features like AI and machine learning integration, as well as big data processing through Google BigQuery

Docker & Kubernetes 4 We use Docker for containerization, ensuring your application runs consistently across environments

Kubernetes helps us manage and scale large applications, providing high availability and automatic rollbacks

Mobile and Cross-Platform Solutions In addition to web applications, we excel in creating mobile-first solutions that deliver an optimal experience across devices

React Native For cross-platform mobile applications, we use React Native to ensure fast development cycles while maintaining a native-like user experience

Apps built with React Native are highly performant and share much of the codebase with their web counterparts

Flutter We also work with Flutter to create native iOS and Android applications from a single codebase

This ensures a consistent look and feel across both platforms while reducing development costs

DevOps Tools To ensure smooth development and deployment processes, we use a wide range of DevOps tools

Git/GitHub/GitLab We rely on Git for version control, ensuring that our codebase is always secure, up-to-date, and easily scalable

CI/CD Pipelines (Jenkins, CircleCI) We automate the testing and deployment of your application using CI/CD pipelines that allow us to quickly identify bugs and reduce the time to market

Discover the best technologies and tools Align with your vision and delight your customers!

Our Fixed-Price Guarantee This rate card outlines each developer level's skills and technologies, offering insights into what to expect at different pricing tiers

It’s designed to help you make informed decisions based on the complexity and needs of your web application project

Level: 1-3 years Basic web frameworks (HTML/CSS, JavaScript), basic React, PHP, simple databases

Handles simple projects (landing pages, basic CMS, small web apps)

Basic manual testing, simple deployment using shared hosting or basic cloud services

Limited understanding, relies on templates or simple design systems

Best for startups on tight budgets, simple MVPs, static or small dynamic sites

Level: 3-5 years Intermediate React, Angular, MERN stack, Laravel, API integration

Medium complexity (e-commerce, dynamic web apps, REST APIs)

Full MERN, LAMP stack, API development, intermediate React

Proficient in modern frontend frameworks (React, Angular) and mid-level backend development (Node.js, Express) Automated testing, CI/CD pipeline setup, scalable cloud solutions (AWS, Azure) Moderate understanding of UI/UX principles with practical implementation Best for mid-sized businesses, moderate complexity apps, scalable solutions Starting At $2900 /mo

Level: 5+ years Advanced technologies (React Native, Node.js, Java, microservices, AWS)

Complex and scalable solutions (enterprise apps, multi-service apps, mobile apps with heavy backend)

Full-stack, advanced frameworks (React Native, Node.js, Java, AWS, microservices)

DevOps capabilities, scalable architecture setup, optimized cloud deployment

Mastery of frontend-backend synergy, integration of complex APIs, optimized data handling

Strong UI/UX knowledge with design refinement capabilities

Best for large enterprises, full-stack solutions, mobile-first web apps, multi-region support

In case you need a bigger web development team then refer to our 'Dev Team Plans’ or you can set up a ‘Discovery Call’

Our Development Process: A Results-Driven Approach As you are searching for a custom web app development company, it's smart to know the whole process before partnering

Discovery Phase & Market Research First up is market research - it's vital

Without knowing your market, your app might miss the mark

Identify the Target Audience We pinpoint specific demographics like age, gender, location, income level, interests, and pain points

For instance, if we're building an e-commerce app, we determine who the potential buyers are, what drives their purchases, and their preferred online shopping habits

Analyze Competitors We study the existing apps within your industry

What features do competitors offer? How user-friendly are their interfaces? What are the gaps we can fill to give your app an edge? Industry Trends Then, we evaluate emerging technologies and evolving consumer behavior

This research allows us to understand the landscape thoroughly, set the right goals, and map out the project

Software Requirement Specification (SRS) & BRDs Once the research is done, the next step is to define the project’s exact requirements by creating an SRS document

This document outlines everything your web app will do—both in terms of functionality and performance

An example breakdown for a Progressive Web Application (PWA): Category Functional Requirements Non-Functional Requirements Performance Load quickly on any network, cache content for offline use Optimize for low bandwidth and limited connectivity Responsiveness Load quickly on any network, cache content for offline use Ensure consistent user experience across all devices Push Notifications Allow users to receive personalized notifications Ensure reliability and timeliness of notifications Security Implement secure authentication and user data protection Use HTTPS and encrypt all sensitive data The SRS serves as the blueprint for the project, guiding developers and ensuring that everyone is on the same page regarding expectations

Choosing the Technology Stack The technology stack defines the app’s performance, scalability, and ease of maintenance

So, we choose the right tech stack based on your app’s functionality, user needs, and future growth

Our Client-Side Technologies (Frontend) In addition to web applications, we excel in creating mobile-first solutions that deliver an optimal experience across devices

Static Web Apps Use HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for simple websites

Dynamic Web Apps For complex, interactive apps, we use libraries like VBScript, React (JavaScript), Angular (TypeScript), or Vue.js (JavaScript)

Server-Side Technologies (Backend) To ensure smooth development and deployment processes, we use a wide range of DevOps tools

PHP Works well with frameworks like Laravel for building scalable and versatile applications

It’s often paired with frameworks like Express.js for APIs or Nest.js for more structured apps

Python (Django, Flask) Ideal for building scalable, secure web applications

Ruby (Rails) Developer-friendly, convention-focused

Ideal for quick database-driven web app development

Java (Spring, Struts) Perfect for enterprise-level applications requiring security, scalability, and performance

Full-stack framework for diverse applications integrates well with Microsoft tech

Selecting the Right Web Development Methodology The development methodology shapes the project’s workflow

The choice depends on the project size, complexity, and flexibility required

Methodology Key Features Suitable For Agile Iterative development, fast feedback, adaptable scope Projects requiring frequent changes, like startups or fast-evolving businesses Waterfall Sequential phases, fixed scope Large projects with well-defined requirements and minimal changes Spiral Iterative with risk analysis, adaptable Complex, high-risk projects with changing requirements For most custom web apps, Agile is ideal as it allows continuous feedback, rapid prototyping, and easy adjustments

Designing the Interface A well-designed interface ensures users can easily interact with the app, driving engagement

We focus on two key aspects: Minimalism and Usability Modern apps are clean and focused

So, we design interfaces that guide users intuitively without overwhelming them with options

Prototyping We create interactive prototypes to test the design with real users before development

This allows us to refine the user experience early on, saving time and ensuring the app meets user expectations

Front-End and Back-End Development Once the design is finalized, development begins

This phase includes two primary parts: first, focus on building the user interface using technologies like React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (Front-End Development)

Then, deals with the server side, ensuring data processing, storage, and retrieval (Back-End Development) 7

Quality Assurance (QA) Before launching your app, we conduct rigorous testing to ensure every feature operates smoothly and securely

Our comprehensive QA process includes: Functional Testing Verifies that each feature of the app functions as intended

Performance Testing Assesses the app’s speed, responsiveness, and stability under varying conditions

Security Testing Protects sensitive user data by identifying and addressing vulnerabilities like SQL injection and cross-site scripting

Bug Fixes Identify and resolve bugs to ensure the app runs seamlessly and securely

User Acceptance Testing (UAT) We collect feedback from a select group of users or stakeholders including our team members who test the app to confirm it meets business requirements and user expectations

After that, we leverage advanced tools and AI-driven testing to detect potential issues early, ensuring your app is ready for real-world use

Why We Introduce AI in Automated Testing Speed and Efficiency AI-driven testing accelerates the testing process, ensuring faster launches and continuous testing without downtime

Higher Accuracy AI identifies patterns in historical data, predicting issues and uncovering bugs that human testers might overlook

Real-Time Issue Resolution AI's predictive analytics alert our development team to potential issues before they escalate, ensuring smooth functionality

Cost Effectiveness Automated testing reduces reliance on manual labor, lowering costs for our clients while maintaining thorough quality checks

Deployment and Launch Once testing is complete, we prepare your app for launch

Whether it’s hosted on a private server or a cloud service like AWS, we handle the deployment process to ensure the app is correctly configured on your server or cloud platform and is accessible to users without any downtime

Post-Launch Support and Maintenance After launch, continuous monitoring and updates are also included in our custom web app development service to ensure your app stays current and functional

This includes: Bug Fixes Addressing any post-launch issues

Performance Monitoring Ensuring the app runs smoothly even as traffic grows

Feature Updates Adding new features based on user feedback or business needs

Common Mistakes During Custom Web App Development — We Always Avoid These! As a seasoned custom web application development company, we’ve seen it all

Here’s our expert take on the pitfalls to avoid: 1

Skimping on Planning Many rush into coding without a solid plan

Proper planning saves time, money, and headaches down the road

So, we always start with a thorough discovery phase, mapping out your needs, user journeys, and technical requirements

Will your app keep up? Too often, developers build for the now, not the future

This means choosing the right architecture, using modular code, and planning for increased data and user loads

Overlooking User Experience (UX) Functionality is key, but usability is king

We've seen powerful apps fail because they're too complex or unintuitive

Our approach? We involve UX designers early and often

So, we can create wireframes, conduct user testing, and iterate based on feedback

Neglecting Mobile Responsiveness In today's mobile-first world, this is a cardinal sin

We ensure your web app looks and works great on all devices

This isn't just about resizing – it's about rethinking layouts and interactions for touch interfaces and smaller screens

Cutting Corners on Security Security can't be an afterthought

We've seen the fallout from data breaches – it's not pretty

Our team bakes security into every layer of your app, uses the latest encryption methods, implements robust authentication, and follows best practices for data protection

Poor API Integration In our connected world, your app doesn't exist in isolation

Right? And, Clunky API integrations can cripple an otherwise great app

So, we specialize in seamless integrations, whether it's with third-party services or your existing systems to make your app play nice with others

Ignoring Performance Optimization Slow is the new down

We've optimized 1000+ apps, and we bring that expertise to your project

Skipping Thorough Testing Bugs are costly – in time, money, and reputation

Yet, we often see testing treated as an afterthought

As I already mentioned, we implement rigorous testing protocols, including unit tests, integration tests, and user acceptance testing to catch issues before your users do

Lack of Documentation Good documentation is like a good insurance policy – you hope you won't need it, but you're glad it's there when you do

We create comprehensive documentation for your app

This aids in maintenance, enables smoother handovers, and helps with future enhancements

Neglecting Post-Launch Support The journey doesn't end at launch

We've seen great apps falter due to poor maintenance

We monitor performance, apply updates, and stand ready to address any issues

Why Build a Custom Web Application? Here we highlight some key reasons why you should invest in custom web applications for your business

Tailored to Your Needs Off-the-shelf solutions often fall short

We build them from the ground up, with your specific goals in it

By automating repetitive tasks and simplifying workflows, your team can focus on what really matters and it cuts a week-long process down to a few clicks

Grow Without Growing Pains Business is unpredictable

Right? You might be small today, but what about tomorrow? Custom web apps are built to scale

Stand Out from the Crowd In today's market, being different is good

They let you offer unique services or create better user experiences

While your competitors struggle with generic tools, you'll have a solution that sets you apart

It's not just about keeping up – it's about staying ahead

Keep Your Data Safe Security isn't optional anymore

Custom web apps let you build security from the ground up

We use the latest tech and best practices to keep your data safe

No more worrying about whether a one-size-fits-all solution covers all your bases

With a custom app, you're in control of your security

Integrate Seamlessly Your business doesn't run on just one system

We can connect your new app with your existing tools, from CRMs to accounting software

No more copy-pasting between programs or dealing with clunky workarounds

Everything works together, smoothly and efficiently

Need to add a new feature to match a market trend? We can do that

With custom development, you're not at the mercy of a vendor's update schedule

You can adapt your tools as quickly as you adapt your business

Support That Understands You When you need help, you don't want to be just another ticket in a queue

With a custom web app, you get support from people who know your business and your software inside out

No more generic troubleshooting or being passed from department to department

Lower Long-Term Costs Yes, custom development is an investment

You're not constantly buying new software as you outgrow the old

In the long run, a web app can be the most cost-effective choice

At the end of the day, a custom web app is your asset

That means you're building value in your business with every improvement and addition

It's an investment in your company's future, not just a cost of doing business
